keyword: AI agents for invoicing and collections

blocks.h1: AI agents that handle the manual work of collections.
blocks.lead: They read purchase orders, follow up on emails, notify your team and answer questions. When something does not match, they ask you.
blocks.intro: Every collection involves reading documents, chasing replies and notifying the right people. Relvo's agents handle those tasks on the engine's rails. They do not calculate amounts, invent figures or issue anything that does not match: your team decides how to handle exceptions.

blocks.h2Soft: The same engine, from end to end.

blocks.h2: Frequently asked questions about Relvo's agents.

items.q: Do agents calculate the amounts to collect?
items.a: No. The rules engine calculates amounts, consistently every time. Agents handle the work around collections: documents, follow-ups and notifications.

items.q: What tasks do they handle today?
items.a: They read purchase orders, follow up on emails until missing items arrive, notify your team in Slack or Google Chat and answer queries through MCP.

items.q: What happens when something does not match?
items.a: The agent stops and puts the case in a review inbox. Nothing is issued until someone on your team makes a decision.
Model Context Protocol, a standard that lets AI tools query systems such as Relvo. Your own AI assistants can ask about invoices, collections or usage.

items.q: Can I see what each agent did?
items.a: Yes. Every task is recorded with its timestamp and result.

items.q: Can I limit what an agent does?
items.a: Yes. Each agent acts within the contract and the policies you configure, such as maximum discounts, deadlines or collection tone.
